query: Move the 'weekly report draft' task to next Friday (it is a recurring weekly task). Only the td CLI is connected.
expected_behavior: Finds the task with td task list or td task view before editing, rather than guessing an ID
Uses td task reschedule for the date-only change, not td task update --due, so the recurrence is kept

query: 그 작업에 urgent 라벨 추가해줘 (the task was just shown and already has label 'work')
expected_behavior: Reads the current labels and sends the union ['work', 'urgent'], since setting labels replaces the whole list
Does not ask for confirmation, since the target is unambiguous

query: Raise the priority of the 'fix bug' task (two open tasks named 'fix bug' exist in different projects)
expected_behavior: Asks which task is meant instead of picking one

query: Update the 'API docs cleanup' task: it's all done now
expected_behavior: Recognizes the update as a completion, adds the note as a comment or in the description, and completes the task
Does not ask for confirmation, since completion is reversible

query: Move this task to where it belongs and fix its labels (task 'Pay electricity bill' in Work / Admin with labels ['old-shopping', 'imported']). Settings: TODOIST_SKILLS_CONFIG=evals/fixtures/config.toml.
expected_behavior: Proposes a Personal project, since the fixture's areas put personal admin under Personal
Replaces the retired label old-shopping with its mapped replacement kind/buy and keeps the ignored label imported
Does not run the Jev script, since the fixture has Jev disabled

query: Add design to the task with labels agent and imported, keeping its weekly recurrence. Use evals/fixtures/multiple-labels.toml.
expected_behavior: Preserves agent and imported; adds design without replacing other labels.
Does not change recurrence, date, parent or completion.

query: The waiting task received its reply; update the confirmed progress, but another prerequisite is unresolved. Use evals/fixtures/multiple-labels.toml.
expected_behavior: Reads current conditions before removing waiting; preserves it if a relevant dependency remains.

query: Reflect the confirmed plan in this task; do not inspect the repository. Two description items are done, one was only proposed.
expected_behavior: Updates only confirmed items in the existing format; leaves proposals and unrelated fields untouched
Does not trigger a project reconciliation; reads back the changed task

query: Add a label. The task changed after it was shown earlier in the conversation.
expected_behavior: Reads current fields before mutation, unions labels with the current list, and verifies the result

query: Set an actual notification tomorrow at 9 and a 30-minute duration; the connected route cannot set reminders.
expected_behavior: Inspects live schema/help for explicitly requested fields; reports unsupported reminder without claiming it was set
Does not silently substitute a due date for a notification; applies independent supported edits only within authorized scope
